# The Code Brains (TCB) — Custom AI Agents & Intelligent Workflow Automation Studio

> Custom Autonomous AI Agents, Real-Time Voice Telephony, RAG Knowledge Vaults, and Enterprise Workflow Automations engineered for production with 100% IP ownership and zero vendor lock-in.

## Overview
The Code Brains (TCB) is a specialized AI engineering studio that designs, builds, and deploys tailor-made autonomous AI systems for businesses worldwide. Rather than selling generic, recurring SaaS subscriptions, TCB develops private, production-grade AI infrastructure deployed directly into the client's cloud accounts (AWS/GCP) with complete source code handover.

## Core Capabilities & Services
- **Autonomous AI Agents & Lead Generation**: 24/7 intelligent agents that qualify inbound prospects, triage complex requests, schedule calendar appointments, and synchronize two-way with CRMs (HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho).
- **Sub-350ms Real-Time Voice Telephony Agents**: Low-latency conversational voice agents running on Twilio SIP trunks, Deepgram Nova-2 speech-to-text, and ElevenLabs neural audio synthesis with interruptible dialogue and deterministic human escalation.
- **Enterprise RAG Knowledge Vaults**: Zero-hallucination vector search systems running on Pinecone and Qdrant, ingesting proprietary documents, policies, and ERP databases with AES-256 encryption.
- **Multi-Step Workflow Automations**: Production n8n and Make pipelines orchestrating data flows across CRMs, messaging channels (WhatsApp Business API, Slack), and custom database webhooks.
- **AI Document & Invoice OCR Extraction**: Multimodal vision AI pipelines parsing unstructured PDFs, scanned contracts, and complex invoices into validated JSON.

## Key Differentiators
- **100% Source Code & IP Ownership**: Code is pushed to your internal GitHub repositories upon delivery.
- **Direct Cloud & API Billing**: AWS hosting and LLM token costs (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini) are billed directly to your corporate accounts with zero agency markup.
- **Enterprise Data Security**: Zero-retention agreements; client data is never used to train external public foundation models.
